title: Move off Coolify
subtitle: Four steps, one server at a time. Nothing changes until you press a button, and every step can be undone until the cleanup.
navHint: Walk the whole move: take over in place, clean up, consolidate projects, shut Coolify down.

noServers: No Coolify server is known yet. Connect your Coolify host first; Tugra then finds the servers it manages.
hostOnly: Your Coolify host manages no other server. Its own apps and databases run on the host itself: copy them to another server with an import, then shut Coolify down in step D.

prelude.title: Before you start
prelude.desc: Connect the Coolify host so Tugra can read it. Nothing on it is changed.

line.hubLast: The Coolify host is shut down last, in step D.

stage.cleanup: Check and clean up Coolify's leftovers
stage.done: Done: Coolify is cleaned off this server
stage.hub: Shut down last, with Coolify itself

card.title: Move off Coolify
card.desc: Where this server stands. Each line opens the screen where you press the button.

takeover.title: A. Take over in place
takeover.desc: Each app and database starts under Tugra on the machine it already runs on. No data is copied; the ports are handed over after every domain has been tested.

cleanup.title: B. Clean up Coolify
cleanup.desc: Once Tugra has everything, remove what Coolify left on each server. A checklist compares every item first.

consolidate.title: C. Consolidate projects
consolidate.desc: Optional. Move a whole project to another server with Move project on its page, then shut down the servers that are empty.

shutdown.title: D. Shut down Coolify
shutdown.desc: Last. When every server is cleaned and the host's own apps are moved to another server, Coolify can be shut down.

step.noRows: No server to work on in this step.

consent.open: Allow or stop reading secret values
consent.intro: Tugra can read Coolify's secret values (environment variables, database passwords, storage keys) so a takeover or move needs no re-typing. Each value is decrypted on the Coolify server and sealed for your hub.
